description: Packaged food by barcode (EAN-8, UPC-A, EAN-13 or GTIN-14) or by name: product name, brand, quantity, Nutri-Score, NOVA group, nutrients per 100 g (energy, fat, saturated fat, carbohydrates, sugars, fibre, protein, salt), allergens, labels, ingredients text and front image URL. Open Food Facts data (ODbL, attribution in source). A barcode not in the database is a 404, not charged. Community data: values can be missing or wrong. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

limit.description: Results for a name search, 1 to 20, default 5

name.description: Product name words, 2 to 100 characters (optional, when no barcode)
